verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's docs show a single completion() interface for any provider, with responses normalized to the OpenAI Chat Completions format. GitHub describes drop-in OpenAI compatibility for swapping providers without code changes. Community launch threads corroborate this: users praise it for standardizing many AI APIs, and the maintainer confirms streaming and function-calling work the same way as the openai-python SDK. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of per-provider feature parity and edge-case consistency across the full 100+ provider set.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call many model providers through one consistent API

citations.quote: Call any provider using the same completion() interface, with no API to re-learn for each one
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
Drop-in OpenAI compatibility — swap providers without rewriting your code
Consistent output format regardless of which provider or model you use
